patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I ran out of my blood-pressure medicine and my doctor's office is closed for the weekend. I feel completely fine — no headache, no chest pain — I just need a refill to get me through.
presentation.triageNote: 55-year-old male, asymptomatic, out of his antihypertensive medication and requesting a bridge refill, with a mildly elevated blood pressure and normal exam.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this asymptomatic routine medication-refill request has only mildly elevated blood pressure, a normal examination, and no counted emergency resource need.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has run out of routine antihypertensive medication but has no symptoms or evidence of acute end-organ injury.
clinical.acuityReason: A mildly elevated blood pressure without symptoms and a normal examination support a bridge plan rather than emergency testing.
teachingPoints: Chest pain, neurologic deficit, dyspnea, vision change, severe headache, or markedly abnormal pressure would require evaluation for acute injury.
Continuity planning helps prevent repeated medication gaps.

possibleDiagnoses: Medication access problem without acute illness
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: A limited bridge prescription and primary-care follow-up would allow discharge without testing.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 55-year-old man, seated comfortably on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: relaxed, hands in his lap. Expression: calm and patient. Clearly visible: a healthy, well-looking man with no distress. No text, no logos.
